google.maps.link.description: Would you like to add another Google Maps account to integrate it into your automation with the help of Dulno? Just click on the logo.
google.maps.action.geocode.name: Find coordinates
google.maps.action.geocode.description: Is used to find the coordinates of a location
google.maps.action.geocode.input.account: The Google Maps account to be used
google.maps.action.geocode.input.query.d: The location whose coordinates are to be searched for (city, address, ...). Any search term
google.maps.action.geocode.failure.accou: An error occurred while finding location coordinates with Google Maps. The error occurred because the selected Google Maps account could not be found.
google.maps.action.geocode.failure.geoco: An error occurred while finding location coordinates with Google Maps. The error occurred because the location you are looking for is unknown.
google.maps.action.places.search.name: Search places
google.maps.action.places.search.descrip: Used to search for different places, people and companies
google.maps.action.places.search.input.a: The Google Maps account to be used
google.maps.action.places.search.input.q: The term you want to search for. Can be a place, a person or a company
google.maps.action.places.search.input.l: The latitude of the place in whose radius you want to search
The longitude of the place in whose radius you want to search
google.maps.action.places.search.input.r: The radius in which you want to search around the location
google.maps.action.places.search.input.p: The number of pages of places you want to retrieve. Each page has 20 locations. You can call up a maximum of 3 pages
google.maps.action.places.search.failure: An error occurred while searching places with Google Maps. The error occurred because the selected Google Maps account could not be found.
An error occurred while searching places with Google Maps. The error has occurred because the latitude, longitude, radius or sides have not been set correctly.
google.maps.action.place.details.name: Find place details
google.maps.action.place.details.descrip: Is used to obtain even more precise information about a certain location
google.maps.action.place.details.input.a: The Google Maps account to be used
google.maps.action.place.details.input.p: The ID of the place for which you would like to receive more detailed information
google.maps.action.place.details.failure: An error occurred while finding details about a place with Google Maps. The error occurred because the selected Google Maps account could not be found.
